title: pvAVSUCDReader
body:
## pvAVSUCDReader

Reads AVS Unstructured Cell Data files (.inp, ASCII or binary) into an unstructured grid with optional point (node) and cell arrays. Several files in FileNames form a time series. Use it for meshes and results exported in AVS UCD form by FE or CFD tools.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only the arrays named in the file are available; coordinates are used as written, with no unit conversion.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `AVSUCDReader`. Identity: `sources/AVSucdSeriesReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of the cell-data components in the UCD file to read as cell arrays. Listing names is exclusive: ParaView switches every other available name off, so include all you need; an empty list reads none. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Names of the node-data components in the UCD file to read as point arrays. Listing names is exclusive: ParaView switches every other available name off, so include all you need; an empty list reads none. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAVSUCDReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
